name: pi-openrouter-top
description: Replaces pi's OpenRouter model list with a curated top-50 snapshot (top-weekly ranks from https://openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly, refreshed 2026-11-20). Provider override is fed from openrouter-top50.json in this repo, preserving per-model api, baseUrl, thinkingLevelMap, compat, and inputLimits.
